result: We ran the slides-first planner on board types it never practiced on. Larger boards (32x32): 174 of 175 solved, and 17 solutions got shorter while none got longer. Crowded boards (8 robots): 23 solutions shorter, none longer, and the biggest cut in wasted moves of any size. Hard crowded puzzles: 276 of 289 solved, a program record.
conclusion: The fix is a property of the method, not of one board size. It worked everywhere, with no extra training.
